ops.text: The stage ends on the firm bank a step short of the pier foot. Both of its ends rest on ground, so no rope hangs over a join. The one mined dock corner would turn the stage south or east into the water, away from the Lilmoth track.
walk 12 close-out: the north-side hull, moored alongside pier-sol9 where the water deepens past the shelf (3.7 m), leaving pier-sol10 to the lighter

The lighter lies alongside pier-sol10 on its north side, parallel to the pier like the rafts, in 3.7 m of water. It floats on its line, so it has no fixed plank. The crew step down from the pier onto its low deck.

The sign hangs from its own arm on the aftcastle's planked north wall, 3.8 m over the water, turned to square with the angled wall. The board hangs over the water beside the pier, about 2 m above the deck. The old hang sat on a rigging card.
